front.title: Guidelines for Combining Opus In-Band Forward Error Correction with the RTP Generic FEC (ULPFEC) Payload Format

abstract.t:
The Opus codec can carry low-bitrate redundancy for the preceding frame inside each packet ("in-band FEC"). The RTP payload format for generic Forward Error Correction (RFC 5109, commonly called ULPFEC) protects groups of RTP packets with XOR parity packets. The two mechanisms recover different loss patterns, have different delay and overhead characteristics, and interact in ways that are not described in either specification.
This document gives informational guidance on when the combination is worthwhile, how a sender should configure each mechanism, how a receiver should order recovery, how to signal the combination in SDP, how middleboxes affect it, and how to keep the combined redundancy consistent with congestion control. It complements, and does not change, the WebRTC FEC requirements in RFC 8854. It defines no new protocol elements.
